data.gender_notes: Nandalal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nanda refers to Nandini, the divine cow and Lord Shiva's consort. 'Lal' is a term of endearment meaning 'beloved' or 'dear'. Thus, Nandalal signifies 'the beloved of Nandini' or 'Lord Shiva's dear one'. The name Nandalal carries the meaning “Lord of Nandini” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nandalal usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of nandini and live with faith, good character and purpose.
